title: eSports Management
desc: Plan and run a small eSports team, club or tournament: roster, schedule, wellbeing, fair play, finance and sponsors.
outcomes: Explain how eSports teams and events work.
Judge wellbeing, fair play and contracts.
task: Plan and run a one-day small tournament or a one-month team season, with roster, rules, wellbeing plan, budget and report.
condition: A game with free play, a computer or consoles, a spreadsheet, two peers and a mentor.
standard: Rules are published; fair-play and anti-cheat steps are used; wellbeing plan limits hours and includes breaks; budget totals correct; report with results; peers rate Meets or better.
who: Club leaders, coaches, event organisers, students.
evidence: roster, rules, schedule, wellbeing plan, budget, report
